claim: The S20 loader's g_3DA4 and g_3DA8 pointer slots are source-shaped native pointer owners. root:m1B4E.asm initializes each DOS far-pointer slot to null; generated S20 procedures assign pointers returned by the actual database loader. A pre-g912C native view measures the registered handle payload containing g_3DA8 and borrows it without copying or guessing a size.
nonclaims: The native pointers do not preserve 16-bit far-pointer serialization or DOS DGROUP layout.
The database handle manager owns resource payloads; this owner does not copy, allocate, lock, or free them.
The g_3DA8 borrowed view uses the remaining bytes in its registered payload; no font bitmap extent or pixels are inferred.
